`enum TextMode`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.text` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextMode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/text/TextMode.java)

How a text fits a box, on one line, cut, wrapped, or wrapped and clipped.

## Learn more

- [Text](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text/)
- [Drawing shapes and text](/use/learn/going-further/drawing/)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`NORMAL`](#TextMode-value-NORMAL) | Draws the text on one line, aligned in the box, even when it is wider than the box. |
| [`OVERFLOW`](#TextMode-value-OVERFLOW) | Draws the text on one line and cuts it to the width of the box, ending with the overflow marker of the [`Text`](/reference/text/text/). |
| [`SPLIT`](#TextMode-value-SPLIT) | Wraps the text into lines that fit the width of the box; the lines may run past its bottom. |
| [`BOX`](#TextMode-value-BOX) | Wraps the text like `SPLIT` and skips the lines that do not fit inside the height of the box. |

## Value details

<a id="TextMode-value-NORMAL"></a>

### NORMAL

`NORMAL` 

Draws the text on one line, aligned in the box, even when it is wider than the box.

<a id="TextMode-value-OVERFLOW"></a>

### OVERFLOW

`OVERFLOW` 

Draws the text on one line and cuts it to the width of the box, ending with the overflow marker of the [`Text`](/reference/text/text/).

<a id="TextMode-value-SPLIT"></a>

### SPLIT

`SPLIT` 

Wraps the text into lines that fit the width of the box; the lines may run past its bottom.

<a id="TextMode-value-BOX"></a>

### BOX

`BOX` 

Wraps the text like `SPLIT` and skips the lines that do not fit inside the height of the box.
